goal: Distributed leasing and concurrency in backend/services/research_factory/

features_delivered: Atomic job leasing via PostgreSQL SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED in lease_next_job with short-lived database transactions, preventing long row-locks across network calls
Configurable lease TTL and atomic renewal with heartbeat tracking in renew_lease, checking active lease tokens and worker pod ownership

Negative abuse defense: Two worker pods running concurrently cannot lease the same task simultaneously (proven via concurrent multi-threaded barrier tests where exactly 1 pod wins and the other skips with None)
Split-brain defense: Stale workers whose lease expired cannot renew or complete jobs; attempts are strictly rejected with LeaseLostError

Distributed provider semaphores (acquire_provider_slot, release_provider_slot, renew_provider_slot) using transactional PostgreSQL serialization and active lease weighting to enforce external AI/OCR concurrency caps across multi-container deployments
Synchronous and asynchronous context manager DistributedProviderSemaphore supporting with and async with with automatic permit acquisition, polling timeout, and guaranteed cleanup
Automatic expiration eviction and daemon recovery in recover_expired_leases to reclaim abandoned or crashed worker tasks back to QUEUED or mark FAILED when max_attempts is exceeded
Sweep-line algorithm implementation (measure_overlapping_tasks) and ConcurrencyTracker for measuring peak overlapping concurrent task executions with millisecond precision
Real-time database active concurrency monitoring via measure_active_concurrency inspecting active leases, queued jobs, completed counts, and provider semaphore allocations
